The '''Tangar system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Fath sector/Legends|Fath sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] and contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tangar]].<ref name="EAOC" />
